datasets.name: Landslide inventory (Shuzheng Valley and Detuo town)
datasets.verbatim: We manually interpreted remote sensing images of landslides in the two study areas and used Shuzheng Valley and Detuo town as test areas and the remaining areas as training areas.

methods.name: MFLD-Net (Multiscale feature fusion landslide-detection network)
methods.summary: An encoder-decoder fully convolutional network that uses ResNet101 as a backbone, incorporates a spatial-ASPP module for multiscale feature extraction, and utilizes transposed convolution layers in the decoder for pixel-level landslide segmentation.
methods.verbatim: The code used during the current study is available from (qu-yu/Spectral_Landslide_detecetion (github.com)).
